_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/combat/test_goad_without_goaded.py. t_kgw_taunt is Kardur, Doomscourge's first sentence as a sorcery, so the shared goad helpers can cast it with three Mountains. t_kgw_kardur is the whole printed card: the same op on an enters trigger, and 'Whenever an attacking creature dies' as a leaves_battlefield trigger to the graveyard gated on the was_attacking binding.

cards.name: Test Doomscourge Taunt
cards.oracle_text: Until your next turn, creatures your opponents control attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.

cards.name: Test Kardur
cards.oracle_text:
When Test Kardur enters, until your next turn, creatures your opponents control attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.
Whenever an attacking creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
